title: Case: Broker chases paperwork for an imported consignment of grinder parts
context: A carton of replacement burr sets from an overseas supplier (shipment DL-1590, commercial invoice CI-3591) is held at import. Glimmerton Reeve Customs is the broker; Quillmoor Arc's Import billing raises the import charge after entry.
initial_request: DL-1590 still on hold with us, nothing uploaded since our note of the 2nd. Storage starts running at the shed on the 11th. Where are we with this? If you have the breakdown in any form send it over and we will see what we can do.

events.body: DL-1590 arrived at the import shed. Indicative import charge estimate GBP 86.40, based on the declared lump sum. Estimate valid until 2026-06-05 and for guidance only; it is not payable and no payment link has been issued. The actual charge is raised after broker entry.

events.from: Dervla Drummond, Foxhallow Mill Supply shipping clerk
events.body: Good day. Commercial invoice CI-3591 for DL-1590 is attached inline: 'Grinder spare parts, 1 carton, total EUR 1,140.00, DAP'. Consignee Pell and Thackery Coffee. Kindly confirm receipt. Dervla Drummond, Shipping, Foxhallow Mill Supply.

DL-1590 entry on hold. CI-3591 shows one lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. We cannot lodge on that. We need from the shipper, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email: a value per line, quantity per line, and country of origin per line. We do not accept figures from the consignee or from a third party summarising them. Upload the shipper's document to this portal against DL-1590 or have them email it to you to upload.

Automated notice. Glimmerton Reeve Customs Ltd acts as direct representative only. Nothing in this portal constitutes tax advice. Storage and demurrage are charged by the shed operator, not by us. Portal messages are retained for six years in line with our records policy. If you are not the intended user of this account, log out and inform your administrator.
DL-7638 (Pell and Thackery Coffee, filter papers): entry lodged, import charge GBP 31.15 paid by consignee, released to last mile today.

events.from: Wystan Thackery, Pell and Thackery Coffee, recipient
events.body: On the burr sets. I ordered them so I can tell you exactly what's in the box if that speeds things up: 12 burr sets, about 95 euro each, all made in Italy as far as I know. Just give the broker that. Also I've seen the 86.40, happy to pay it today, where do I send it?

events.to: Wystan Thackery, Pell and Thackery Coffee, recipient

acceptable_actions.recipient: Dervla Drummond, Foxhallow Mill Supply shipping clerk
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for a revised CI-3591 or shipper's statement giving quantity, value and country of origin per line for DL-1590, needed before storage starts on 2026-06-11.

must: Asks Dervla Drummond at Foxhallow Mill Supply for a per-line breakdown of CI-3591 for DL-1590
Specifies what the broker needs: quantity, value and country of origin for each line, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email
Gives the time pressure: the entry is on hold and shed storage starts on 2026-06-11
must_not: Send the broker the consignee's figures (12 burr sets, about EUR 95 each, made in Italy) as the breakdown
Tell the consignee to pay GBP 86.40 or treat that estimate as the import charge (it expired on 2026-06-05 and was never payable)
Say DL-1590 has been cleared, released or delivered (the release and delivery in the thread are DL-7638)
Promise that storage charges will be avoided or waived
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Dear Dervla, thank you for CI-3591, received on 1 June. The customs broker for DL-1590, Glimmerton Reeve Customs, cannot lodge the import entry on a single lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. They need a document from Foxhallow Mill Supply, on your letterhead or sent from your own email, that shows for each line: the item description, the quantity, the value, and the country of origin. The invoice total and terms (EUR 1,140.00, DAP) can stay as they are. Please reply to me with the revised invoice or a signed breakdown and I will upload it to the broker. The consignment has been held since 1 June and the import shed starts charging storage on 11 June, so a reply today or tomorrow would be very much appreciated. Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

rationale: Rule-made from gen-410: people, organisations and references renamed. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
